name: run-tests
description: Run a project's test suite and report failures with the safest fix first.
steps: confirm the project path is inside the allowed workspace
run the project's canonical test command with a timeout
report pass/fail per suite and point at first failure
validation: output includes command run, duration, and pass/fail counts
failure_recovery: on timeout, report the hanging suite and stop
cautions: workspace paths only: never run tests outside the project root
never use --fix, --write, or update flags that modify sources
bounded runtime: kill the runaway process on timeout
